verdict.rationale: First-party Agent API docs say structured output makes the model return JSON that conforms to a schema you define, so it can be deserialized directly. That is the core of the story. The evidence is a single doc statement, and it isn't clear whether this also covers the Sonar chat-completions endpoint. Missing for 10: detailed schema-format documentation (supported JSON Schema features, strictness guarantees), confirmation that it works on the Sonar endpoint itself, independent or hands-on corroboration.
